        SELECT
          r.to_field_id as field_id,

        WHERE df.level < 10  -- Prevent infinite recursion

      SELECT DISTINCT
        f.id,
        f.table_id,
        df.level
      FROM dependent_fields df
      INNER JOIN field f ON f.id = df.field_id
      WHERE f.type = $2
        AND f.deleted_time IS NULL
